description: This PHP abstract class 'AbstractEndpointResult' defines a base structure for API endpoint result objects in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for metadata, relationships, and data normalization, as well as constructor and accessor methods.

classes.name: AbstractEndpointResult
classes.description: An abstract class providing a foundation for API endpoint response objects, handling data normalization, metadata, and relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the result object with a model class, data, and optional metadata and relationships, verifying the class exists.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to convert the object to an associative array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the metadata ParameterBag.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Mutator method to set the metadata ParameterBag.

methods.name: getRels
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the relationships ParameterBag.

methods.name: setRels
methods.description: Mutator method to set the relationships ParameterBag.
